Metadata.title: KOMPOZIT T.A. — GRP Pipes | Dushanbe
Metadata.description: Full-cycle GRP (fiberglass-reinforced plastic) pipe plant in Dushanbe, Tajikistan. Pressure and gravity pipelines for water supply, hydropower, and oil & gas. Service life 50+ years.
Metadata.keywords: GRP pipes, fiberglass pipes, Dushanbe, Tajikistan, KOMPOZIT T.A., pressure pipes, water pipeline
Metadata.ogDescription: Full-cycle GRP pipe plant in Dushanbe. Corrosion resistance, low weight, 50+ year service life.

Home.heroDesc: A full-cycle GRP (glass-reinforced plastic) pipe plant producing diameters from 400 to 3000 mm. Corrosion resistant, lightweight, with a design life of 50+ years.
Home.advantagesTitle: A material that will outlast metal
Home.advantage1Text: Full resistance to corrosion, aggressive soils, and stray currents — no cathodic protection required.
Home.advantage2Text: Low weight cuts transport and installation costs. Long sections can be laid without heavy machinery.
Home.advantage3Text: Low surface roughness means lower head loss, higher throughput, and no internal build-up.
Home.ctaDesc: Send us your project parameters — diameter, pressure, length, and medium. We'll prepare a technical proposal and pricing within two business days.

Home.certsDesc: Our quality management system is certified by the state authorities of the Republic of Tajikistan, and the testing laboratory sits on the plant site. Every batch is tested before shipment.
Home.certsBadge3: Product catalogue, project album and installation manual
Home.esgDesc: Production, products and contribution to the national economy — in verifiable figures.

About.leadPara2: The plant was founded as a joint venture between Avesto Group (Tajikistan) and Azcomposit (Azerbaijan). Production is built on continuous filament-winding technology.

News.n1Title: Grand opening of the KOMPOZIT T.A. plant
News.n1Excerpt: A full-cycle GRP pipe plant launched in Dushanbe with the President of Tajikistan in attendance.
News.n1Body1: On August 28, 2021, the grand opening ceremony of the KOMPOZIT T.A. plant took place with the President of the Republic of Tajikistan, Emomali Rahmon, in attendance.
News.n1Body2: The plant was built in two years on a 4-hectare site as a joint venture between Avesto Group and Azerbaijan's Azcomposit. It produces GRP pipes from 400 to 3000 mm in diameter, fittings, grating, tanks, and poles.
News.n2Title: Over 57,000 meters of GRP pipe installed
News.n2Excerpt: The plant's products have been used on 16 water supply, irrigation, and sewerage projects nationwide.
News.n2Body1: To date, KOMPOZIT T.A. has installed 57,647 meters of GRP pipe across 16 sites.
News.n2Body2: The plant's products have been used on 16 projects — from trunk water mains and irrigation systems to sewer collectors. Project investors include the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the Asian Development Bank, and an EU grant fund.

Production.metaDescription: GRP pipe production by continuous filament winding at the KOMPOZIT T.A. plant in Dushanbe. Diameters from 400 to 3000 mm, sections up to 12 m, every batch inspected.
Production.heroAlt: A finished pipe on a lift in the KOMPOZIT T.A. plant's workshop
Production.sectionDesc: We produce pipelines from 400 to 3000 mm in diameter in long sections: fewer joints on site, faster installation, and consistent quality in every batch.
Production.t1Body1: Continuous filament winding lays glass fiber, saturated with polyester resin, layer by layer onto a rotating mandrel. This is how pipes from 400 to 3000 mm in diameter are made.
Production.t1Body2: The process starts in the Liner unit: an inner barrier layer of resin and glass fiber is formed, then the pipe is dried at the oven. During reinforcement, the Winder unit continuously winds resin-saturated glass roving. Silica sand can be added to the wall to increase ring stiffness.
Production.t1Stage1Text: Forming the inner polyester-resin barrier layer in the Liner unit.
Production.t1Stage2Text: Drying and curing the first layer at the oven.
Production.t1Stage3Text: Continuous winding of the load-bearing glass-roving layer in the Winder unit.
Production.t1Stage4Text: Applying silica sand to increase ring stiffness.
Production.t1Stage5Text: Machining the ends on a lathe and inspecting every batch.
Production.t1Stage6Text: Visual inspection and final finishing before shipment.
Production.t2Body1: Production of high-strength GRP profiles, angles, and pipes from 50 to 300 mm in diameter by pultrusion. Used in anti-corrosion structures with properties that stay constant along their length.
Production.t3Body1: Manufacturing high-strength GRP grating decking resistant to aggressive environments. The production cycle includes winding, resin impregnation, pressing, and heating.
Production.t4Body1: Production of GRP roofing sheets and façade panels — for attractive, durable construction solutions.
Production.t5Body1: Making strong GRP parts — manhole covers and other components — by hot-press molding under up to 800 tons of pressure.
Production.t6Body1: Manufacturing complex composite parts and pipeline fittings to custom technical specifications. Fully hand-made, using polyester resin and glass fiber for an exact match to requirements.

items.title: Composite pipes
items.intro: GRP composite pipes, DN 400–3000, made by continuous filament winding. Bell-and-spigot joints with sealing rings — no-weld installation. Sections from 1.5 to 12 m long.
items.jointDesc: A spigot-into-bell joint: the plain end of one pipe fits into the bell end of the next, sealed by rubber rings. Installed without welding or flanges, with a 235 mm insertion depth. The joint allows axial movement and absorbs the pipeline's thermal expansion.

items.title: Fittings
items.intro: Hand-made GRP shaped fittings: crosses, elbows, reducers, and tees. Socket and flanged joints, DN 400–3000.

items.title: Cross
90° elbow
Concentric reducer
Grating
items.intro: GRP composite grating decking for platforms, walkways, and flooring in aggressive environments: corrosion resistance, low weight, and a non-slip surface.
items.certTitle: Stiffness tested in an accredited laboratory
certLines: Accredited laboratory of KOMPOZIT T.A. LLC (certificate No. TJ 762.37100.02.037-2024).
Methods: BS 4592-0, BS 4592-6, GOST 33376-2015. Equipment: HGW-100.
A 50×50×7 mm sample was tested for bending under a line load across 400–1200 mm spans.
Result: actual deflection was below the normative limit; no cracks, delamination, or failures were found — meets the technical requirements.

Privacy.metaDescription: Privacy and cookie policy of the KOMPOZIT T.A. website.
Privacy.s1Body: The data controller is LLC KOMPOZIT T.A., 90/1 Arbobkhotun Street, Dushanbe, Republic of Tajikistan. For questions about data processing, write to info@composite.tj.
Privacy.s2Body: The site collects only the data you enter yourself in the quotation request form:
Privacy.s2i1: name — required, so that we can address you;
Privacy.s2i2: email address — required, so that we can reply;
Privacy.s2i3: company, phone, country — optional, to prepare the proposal;
Privacy.s2i4: message — the project parameters you provide.
Privacy.s2Note: We use no web analytics, advertising pixels or trackers. The site does not build a visitor profile and does not pass data to advertising networks.
Privacy.s3Body: The data is processed for one purpose only: to prepare and send a reply to your enquiry. The basis is your own step towards entering into a contract — you send the request and expect an answer. By submitting the form you confirm your consent to this processing.
Privacy.s4Title: Who the data is shared with
Privacy.s4Body: The message is delivered through the Resend email service (Resend Inc., USA) to the corporate address info@composite.tj. There are no other recipients. We do not sell or pass your data to third parties for their own purposes.
Privacy.s4Note: When the form is submitted, the server keeps your IP address in memory for no longer than ten minutes, solely to limit spam. The address is not stored anywhere and is not linked to the content of your enquiry.
Privacy.s5Body: Correspondence is kept in the corporate mailbox for as long as it is needed to handle the enquiry and perform any resulting contract, but no longer than three years from the last message. The site has no separate database — enquiries are not stored on the website server.
Privacy.s6Body: The site uses a minimum of cookies:
Privacy.s6i1Body: One file, NEXT_LOCALE, remembers the language you chose — Russian, Tajik or English. Without it the site cannot open a page in the right language. Such files always work and require no consent.
Privacy.s6i2Body: The contacts page embeds a Yandex map. It may set cookies of its own belonging to Yandex. The map loads only after your consent — until then a placeholder with a link to the map is shown instead.
Privacy.s6Note: You can change your choice at any time using the “Cookie settings” button at the bottom of every page.
Privacy.s7Body: You may ask what data we hold about you, request correction or deletion, and withdraw your consent. Write to info@composite.tj — we reply within thirty days.
Privacy.s8Body: If the policy changes, we will update the version date at the top of this page. Material changes will be noted separately.
Privacy.cookieBody: The site needs one file to work — it remembers your language. The Yandex map on the contacts page sets its own files and loads only with your consent.
Privacy.mapBlockedTitle: The Yandex map is not loaded
Privacy.mapBlockedBody: The map is an external service and may set its own cookies. Load it?

Sustainability.metaDescription: Sustainability at KOMPOZIT T.A.: a 292 kW solar plant, pipeline energy efficiency, life-cycle economics and contribution to the local economy of Tajikistan.
Sustainability.heroDesc: How much energy the pipe saves, how long it lasts, and what stays in the country from every order. With figures and their sources.
Sustainability.esg1Body: A 292 kW solar power plant has operated on the factory site since May 2026. It covers up to 80% of the plant's electricity consumption.
Sustainability.esg2Body: The smoothness of GRP (Hazen–Williams coefficient ≈ 150) does not degrade over time — saving 20–30% of pumping station electricity across decades of operation.
Sustainability.esg3Body: Replacing imported heavy steel pipe with local production in Dushanbe cuts transport emissions many times over.
Sustainability.esg4Body: Bell-and-spigot joints with EPDM seals stay tight through seismic shocks, loess subsidence and temperature swings — with no loss of clean drinking water.
Sustainability.tcoTitle: The benefit is counted across the whole service life
Sustainability.tco1Title: Total cost of ownership 40% below steel
Sustainability.tco1Body: The initial investment is offset by the absence of operating costs later on.
Sustainability.tco2Title: Over 50 years of service without corrosion
Sustainability.tco2Body: Water supply projects will not need refinancing to replace pipe after 25 years.
Sustainability.tco3Body: Mains need no cathodic protection stations, as steel does, and no regular cleaning of internal deposits.
Sustainability.localTitle: Production, skills and technology stay in the country
Sustainability.local1Body: Pipe for state projects is made inside the country rather than imported. The plant operates as a local taxpayer and supports related sectors, from transport to construction and installation.
Sustainability.local2Body: More than 100 skilled jobs for local engineers and workers in the industrial cluster.
Sustainability.local3Body: Composite production was set up in partnership with international specialists, raising the country's industrial capability.
Sustainability.local4Body: Shipment from the Dushanbe warehouse straight to site. Installation is 3–4 times faster than steel — projects are handed over on time.
Sustainability.mdbTitle: Already in service on IFI-financed projects
Sustainability.mdbBody: The plant's pipes have passed technical and environmental compliance and are in service on projects of the Asian Development Bank (Kofarnihon station, KAF-1) and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (water mains in Nurek). Production is certified to ISO 9001:2015; the products comply with ISO 10467, ASTM and AWWA.
Sustainability.noteBody: Energy-efficiency and cost-of-ownership figures are taken from the plant's technical documentation and comparative calculations for pipelines of equal diameter. Project volumes come from works acceptance certificates. Detailed calculations for a specific project are available on request.
